sloka: तस्य बाहूरुवेगं च निनादं च महात्मनः ।निशम्य हरयो हृष्टाः समुत्पेतुस्ततस्ततः ।। 5.57.25 ।।।।
transliteration: tasya bāhūruvegaṁ ca ninādaṁ ca mahātmanaḥ ।niśamya harayo hṛṣṭāḥ samutpetustatastataḥ ।। 5.57.25 ।।।।

translations.english: The vanaras were very happy. Longing to see Hanuman, they jumped from one tree top to another and from one peak of a mountain to the other.
